bluf: GDACS reported a magnitude 6.1 earthquake in Fiji at 17:21 UTC, with few people potentially affected within 100km. The Record reported that a ransomware attack disrupted Wi-Fi and on-site computers at Queens Public Library; BBC News World reported evidence of digging and new buildings near Iran missile bases in satellite imagery taken in November.

cyber.text: The Record reported that a ransomware attack disrupted Wi-Fi and on-site computers at Queens Public Library; the library system confirmed the disruption was caused by ransomware.

disasters.text: GDACS reported an earthquake in Fiji at 17:21 UTC with magnitude 6.1 and a depth of 535km; it said few people were potentially affected within 100km.

items.text: BBC News World reported that satellite imagery taken in November showed evidence of digging and new buildings near Iran missile bases.
CBC Calgary reported that three First Nations in Alberta filed legal challenges seeking to overturn the federal government’s national-interest designation of the Pacific Link pipeline.
CBC Calgary reported that Telus said a small number of calls were interrupted in Eastern Canada on Thursday; the company reported that issues in Ontario had since been resolved.
The Guardian World reported that Eva Geller died in hospital almost 12 months after being shot during the Bondi beach attack.
